name: Les Baux de Provence

limits: For red wine, Carignan, Cinsault and Counoise, each: at most 30%
For red wine, Cabernet Sauvignon: at most 20%
For rosé wine, Carignan, Counoise and Mourvèdre, each: at most 30%
For rosé wine, Cabernet Sauvignon: at most 20%
For white wine, Bourboulenc, Marsanne and Ugni Blanc together: at most 30%
For rosé wine, white grapes (Clairette, Grenache Blanc, Vermentino, Roussanne, Bourboulenc, Marsanne, Ugni Blanc) together: at most 10%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Provence appellation of seven communes. Reds are led by Grenache, Mourvèdre and Syrah, and whites use Grenache Blanc, Vermentino and Clairette.
